decision: D3 (owner) as drawn by design round A frames nezetek/workout-finish (Figma 161:2) and nezetek/workout-finish-confirm (171:2)

hand-ins: docs/pipeline/pulse/pkg/S-workout/states.json (generated by fixtures.mjs: 5 new states workout-finish, workout-finish-confirm, workout-finish-failed, workout-finish-done, workout-abandon-done)

deviations.what: The Befejezés link lives in the header line, so it goes with the header line when the Q7 default takes it: at 360 x 640 only while the rest band AND the offline line are both on screen (workout-law-rest-offline.w360, workout-offline-inflight.w360). The link is back as soon as the rest ends or the network returns. While offline a finish would fail anyway (not queued).
deviations.why: Q7 order (figure first, then the header line) is the owner's rule for this column; the finish is not a set control and must not push the active check out of reach.

deviations.what: While an interval block is RUNNING the header actions (Időzítő, Videó, Befejezés) are hidden, as the hero toggle already was; the link returns when the stage is paused or stopped.
deviations.why: A running interval records rounds by itself; ending the session mid-round from the header would race the round's own write. Stopping first is one tap on the stage.

deviations.what: The sheet's content stands 1 pt in from the frame (x 25, w 352 instead of 24 / 354) and the panel starts at y 538 instead of 539.
deviations.why: The kit Sheet draws its 1 px hairS edge as a CSS border inside the panel; the Figma kit keeps the stroke out of the layout. Kit-wide (every sheet), within the 2 pt tolerance; not changed here.

deviations.what: Not drawn by any frame, built in the same language: the in-flight state (the chosen row holds its pressed level, the other row is inert, the sheet header shows the three dots) and the failed state (sheet stays open, danger dot + Újra repeating the same choice). No new copy.
deviations.why: PLAN 4.1 rule 7: undrawn states are built from the kit; a failed end must never look like one that worked.

behaviour.complete: POST /workouts/:id/finish with {} -> completed; then rest and interval timers stop, the sheet closes, the player is marked ended and navigates to / (replace); queries ['workout'], ['today'], ['coin-wallet'], ['coin-ledger'], ['coin-achievements'] are invalidated after the navigation is requested
behaviour.idempotency: the server's guard (status = 'in_progress') makes a second end a 404; on a 404 the hook re-reads /workouts/current and resolves as replayed when that session is no longer live (a retry of an end that landed); any other failure keeps the sheet open with Újra
behaviour.offline: not queued (outbox untouched); a network failure is the sheet's error state
behaviour.summary: '{{done}} sorozat rögzítve · {{left}} hátravan' over the whole session's non-withdrawn sets
